summary_text: On 2026-02-10 (weekday), the user placed one order of fresh vegetables in the afternoon. The basket included local tomatoes, onions, brinjal, organic bottle gourd, baby potatoes, and coriander leaves. This afternoon timing aligns with the population afternoon share (0.2526) but is less common than the population baseline morning share (0.3246). The items are perishable fresh produce typically used for immediate same-day cooking or meal preparation. As this is a single observation from one date, it is not yet established whether this represents a stable routine or a one-time need. No brand preferences can be inferred as all items are unbranded.
